toegepas.voor: Baie van hierdie druppeltjies saam vorm
toegepas.na: Baie van hierdie druppeltjies vorm saam
toegepas.rede_vinder: In Afrikaans the adverb 'saam' follows the finite verb; 'druppeltjies saam vorm' is unnatural word order.
toegepas.fout: 'Baie van hierdie druppeltjies saam vorm' hangs 'saam' after the subject and reads stiffly; 'vorm saam' is the natural order.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Same meaning (the droplets together form a cloud), more natural word order, no protected word touched and no words added.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Nog water' reads as 'even more water'; 'Ander water' says clearly that this is a different part of the rain, matching 'Baie ander water' later in the lesson.
toegepas.fout: 'Nog water' can read as 'yet more water' rather than another part of the same rain.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Ander water' states the partition of the rain clearly, matches 'Baie ander water' in the next block, and adds no words.

toegepas.voor: iets wat oor en oor herhaal
toegepas.na: iets wat oor en oor gebeur
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Herhaal' is transitive in Afrikaans and needs an object or 'hom'; 'gebeur' keeps the meaning without adding a word.
toegepas.fout: 'herhaal' is used intransitively without an object or 'hom', which is not standard Afrikaans.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'gebeur oor en oor' keeps the meaning, fixes the grammar, leaves the protected word 'siklus' intact and keeps the word count the same.

laat_vaar.voor: meestal as reën, en as sneeu
laat_vaar.na: meestal as reën en as sneeu
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: no comma before 'en' between parts of one sentence; the second half has no subject and verb of its own.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The comma marks snow as a separate addition; without it 'meestal' and 'waar dit koud genoeg is' can be read across both rain and snow, so the meaning moves.
